data.name: Asqari
data.gender_notes: Asqari is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Asqar’, meaning ‘Intelligent, Wise’, or ‘Warrior’. This name signifies intelligence, wisdom, and strength. It is a name befitting a leader or one who is highly intelligent. The name Asqari carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asqari usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Asqari is a name with deep spiritual meaning, signifying not only intelligence and wisdom, but also the strength and courage to use that intelligence for the greater good. It is a name that inspires confidence and respect, and is a reminder of the importance of using our gifts and abilities wisely and for the benefit of all.
data.etymology: Asqari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asqari total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.name: اسقری
in_urdu.meaning: اسقری کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی خاص خاندان کی خدمت کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسقری نام کی اصطلاح عربی جڑ 'س ق ر' سے نکلی ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خدمت کرنا یا پیروی کرنا۔ اسلامی سیاق و سباق میں، یہ نام کسی خاص خاندان یا حکمرانی کرنے والے خاندان کی خدمت کرنے والے شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام وفاداری اور خدمت کے احساس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अस्करी

in_english.name: Asqari
in_english.meaning: Asqari refers to a person who serves or follows a particular family
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asqari is derived from the Arabic root 'س ق ر' (s-q-r), which means to serve or follow. In an Islamic context, this name is used to refer to a person who serves or is affiliated with a particular family or ruling dynasty. It signifies loyalty, dedication, and service. Historically, such names were common in royal and noble families across the Islamic world.
